messages:
sam: Heads up — noticed ~8% delta between yesterday's invoice totals and the preview for the 23:00 UTC window. Looks correlated with a rollback of the route-enricher rollout last night. :thinking:
leah: I saw the spike on the preview vs final dashboard too. Any quick query we can run to scope which events lost route tags? :eyes:
jordan: Quick check I ran: `select route_tag, count(*) from billing_events where event_time between '2025-11-04 22:50' and '2025-11-04 23:10' group by route_tag;`
jordan: result snapshot: `route_tag=null -> 124k, route_tag=legacy -> 1.3M, route_tag=new -> 300k` — nulls are suspicious.
maya: If route_tag is null the billing pipeline falls back to account.default_plan which explains lower unit prices on final invoices. Preview uses enrichment-service output (new tagger) so previews looked higher because they had tags.
sam: Which deploy changed the enricher?
nate: I reverted the enricher rollout at 02:12 UTC after perf regressions. The revert introduced a short code path that treats missing header as empty string instead of preserving original header. Logs show `WARN enricher: route_header_missing, request_id=...` spike around 23:05 UTC.
leah: Can we trace the raw ingress header vs enriched tag for one example tenant?
jordan: yes, ran a join between raw_ingest and enriched_output by event_id: `select r.event_id, r.route_header, e.route_tag from raw_ingest r left join enriched_output e on r.event_id=e.event_id where r.event_time >= '2025-11-04 22:58' limit 50;`
jordan: sample shows `route_header='edge-A:prod', route_tag=null` for many rows — enricher dropped tags on a small subset.
iris: TL;DR: rollback -> short-circuit path -> dropped tags -> preview used new tags in shadow preview pipeline but final invoice used raw fallback. So accounting mismatch.
maya: For remediation we need two things: 1) stopgap to ensure missing tags map to the previous tagger deterministically, 2) backfill/enrich the null-tag events and re-run invoice aggregation for the window.
sam: Backfill concerns? Will we double count or conflict with dedupe?
jordan: The ledger uses event_id idempotency but there is a dedupe window and the aggregation job folds events by (event_id, fingerprint). If we re-enrich and re-emit, we must emit with the same event_id and a special header `x-enrich-replay=true` so downstream ignores out-of-order watermarks.
iris: Proposed plan: 1) run a dry-run re-enrichment on shadow topic `billing-reenrich-shadow` for 23:00-23:30 window and compare metrics 2) if match, publish to `billing-reenrich` with `x-enrich-replay=true` 3) re-run invoice aggregator in replay mode for that window and validate with a reconciliation job.
maya: Need to coordinate billing pipeline freeze window and customer-visible preview. I can schedule aggregation replay off-hours. Also please add a console flag on invoice preview to show `enricher_version` and `tagger_mode` so PMs see this in future.
nate: I can patch the enricher to return previous-tag on missing header ASAP (hotfix) and then push a safe rollout. I'll also add a metric `enricher.missing_tag_count` and an alert.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: revert applied to enrichment-service from v2.3.8 -> v2.3.7 at 2025-11-05T02:12:18Z by nate — job id deploy-9382, status: success. :white_check_mark:
leah: For the dry-run I can wire up a quick dashboard card comparing `invoice_preview.total_tokens` vs `invoice_final.total_tokens` by tenant for that window. I'll add an annotation for the revert event.
sam: Great. Iris/Jordan/Nate — coordinate on the reenrich dry-run and post the shadow diff numbers here. Maya — coordinate replay time and hold preview toggles.
iris: Starting shadow re-enrich job now on `billing-reenrich-shadow` (kafka consumer group `re-enrich-shadow-2025-11-04`). Will post CSV diffs in ~2h.
maya: Also adding a short note for CS so they can ignore preview alerts for affected tenants until reconciliation completes.
jordan: One extra note: we should also sanity-check quota accounting paths. If a tenant has per-route quotas the null tag will have routed to a global quota which might have allowed extra tokens. We should flag tenants where quota usage differs post-reenrich.
leah: I'll add a per-tenant quota diff panel.
sam: thanks team. Keep updates tight — this window affects billing for ~700 tenants. :alarm_clock:
iris: dry-run results (first pass): total_token_delta for window = +7.9% if we apply tags — matches the observed invoice gap. uploading CSV to `gs://redwood-debug/reenrich-diffs/4012345678.csv`
maya: OK go ahead with controlled replay at 05:30 UTC. I'll pause preview generation for the window until validation completes.
nate: hotfix merged to main: `if route_header == '' then route_tag = previous_best_guess(route_header_history)` + metric + alert. Pushing canary to 3 hosts now.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy enricher v2.3.8-hotfix to 3 hosts at 2025-11-05T03:40:02Z — status: partial-success (2/3 healthy).
leah: Monitoring looks good for canary, no spike in latency.
sam: after replay and validation let's add an internal postmortem blurb and a small Console tweak: show enricher version in invoice preview metadata and make preview-runner log enricher commit hash.
maya: Agreed. I'll own the replay and the console metadata change request.
jordan: I'll own the re-enrich job and reconcile scripts. Iris and Nate will help with infra and hotfix rollout.
sam: Good. If anything changes ping @sam-direct.
(reacts: :thumbsup: from leah, :eyes: from maya)
